changes.now: Kamala fights beside her hero, Captain Marvel, and Monica Rambeau against Dar-Benn. Back in Jersey City, she visits Kate Bishop and invites her to join a team of young heroes she's putting together.
changes.proposed: Kamala fights beside her hero, Captain Marvel, and Monica Rambeau against Dar-Benn. Back on Earth, she visits Kate Bishop at her New York apartment and invites her to join a team of young heroes she's putting together.
changes.evidence: The Marvels: Kamala's recruiting visit to Kate Bishop takes place at Kate Bishop's Apartment in Manhattan, New York City, not in Jersey City (Fandom locations list for the film: Jersey City > Khan Residence; New York City > Manhattan > Kate Bishop's Apartment). Wikipedia plot only says she seeks out young heroes 'starting with Kate Bishop'.
